method: Keep semantic +3/+2/+1 answer weights, then standardize each personality against its neutral uniform-answer baseline before ranking.
reason: Raw sums structurally favored personalities that appear in more answer weights. Normalization removes that built-in advantage without forcing real user results to be equal.
guardrail: CI simulation should keep neutral-model primary personality share within a broad 8%-18% band. This is a bias detector, not a requirement that production users distribute evenly.
